A Windows tray app that keeps the RGB lighting you chose on an sbarda keyboard: it writes it back at sign-in, on plug-in, after sleep and on every change. Tested on **ZORNER ZH99 HE** (`19F5:FB2A`). See the [README](https://github.com/lostintired/sbarda-kblight#readme) for install steps.

**To update from 1.1.0:** right-click the tray icon → Exit, replace `KbLight.exe` with this one, start it. Your settings stay.

### What's new

- **Update check.** While the tray is running, KbLight asks GitHub for the latest release a minute after start and then once a day. A newer version shows up as a link in the window, one Windows notification and a log line — both open the release page. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically. The request goes to `api.github.com` with `User-Agent: KbLight/<version>` and nothing else; untick **Check for updates** in the window to turn it off ([details](https://github.com/lostintired/sbarda-kblight#updates)).
- **The version is visible:** "KbLight 1.2.0" in the window, in the log at start, and `KbLight.exe --version` (in PowerShell: `KbLight.exe --version | Write-Output`).
- Releases are now built by GitHub Actions from the tag, with the SHA256 below.
